name: galeria-fotos-hrlv
description: Galería fotográfica personal de viajes y paseos.

scripts.start: pnpm run build && web-dev-server --root-dir dist --app-index dist/index.html --port 8000
scripts.start:e2e: FIREBASE_CONFIG_DISABLED=1 pnpm run build && web-dev-server --root-dir dist --app-index dist/index.html --port 8017
scripts.test:likes: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gallery-likes --only auth,database 'node --import tsx --test --test-force-exit test/integration/photo-likes.test.ts'
scripts.test:likes:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gallery-likes --only auth,database 'playwright test --config playwright.likes.config.ts'
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
